name: HoloTiltCard
description: Three-dimensional perspective card with layered Z-depth planes, moving specular highlights, and a pointer-driven shifting holographic foil gradient.
a11yNotes: Smoothly restores the card to its flat resting plane on pointer leave and disables 3D perspective rotation when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

defaultProps.title: Holographic Foil Surface
defaultProps.subtitle: Pointer coordinates drive both 3D perspective pitch/roll and spectral diffraction angle.

propsApi.name: maxTilt
propsApi.description: Maximum pitch and roll tilt angle in degrees.

propsApi.name: holoOpacity
propsApi.description: Opacity of the shifting holographic gradient layer.
